body: READ-ONLY POST-LANDING FINDING on d295f4c: ViaAncestor survives in CommonViewState and the audit-panel text, but receives no visible proxy treatment in the Atlas SVG. AppCompilerSuite proves the compiled ancestor differs from the selected address and has visible marks; AppCompiler nevertheless computes selectedMarks/focusedMarks only with scene.navigation.marksFor(originalAddress), which is empty in that coarse view, and AppView passes only those sets to SvgDom. The smoke checks OnMark classes and ViaAncestor state/text, not the graphical proxy. Full evidence and proposed typed/accessibility-safe repair are on the authoritative board at narrative-visualization-vision/post-01M179BC68AC4RKGWKWB3RNAE2. Important: do not mark the ancestor itself aria-pressed/current as though its identity were selected; use a distinct proxy treatment that names the preserved address. No files edited and no bead claimed.
